name: nontrivial-load
completionClock: browser predicate observation + double-rAF opportunity; not physical scanout or completion of all later app work
feedbackScope: first visible feedback unmeasured; terminal readiness must not be relabelled as feedback
gapScope: post-marker interval may contain app work, later stalls and driver delivery; no pure-overhead attribution
frameScope: per-operation observations may extend past latency marker; session window required for continuous-stall claims
